question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multiple item lines'
  END AS order_type,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS total_units,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY 
  CASE order_type 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Multiple item lines' THEN 2
    ELSE 3 END

action.answer:
In 2025, there were no orders with zero item lines (no such row was returned). Of all orders:

- 1,307,684 orders (about 30%) had exactly one item line, with an average of 1.219753 units per order.
- 3,052,089 orders (about 70%) had multiple item lines, with an average of 3.484769 units per order.

Share of orders with more than one item line: 3,052,089 / (1,307,684 + 3,052,089) = 0.700183 (70.0183%).

Interpretation: The majority of 2025 orders (70.0183%) contained more than one item line, and these multi-line orders had a much higher average number of units per order (3.484769) compared to single-line orders (1.219753). No orders were found with zero item lines in the data.
